references.observation: Oblique river elevation reveals the pointed high central arch, lower side arches, pale square stone courses, fired brick and a marker tower at either end.
Describes a 23 m bridge about 6.3 m wide and 8.3 m tall, with four marker towers and river-stone paving.
The aerial view shows rounded upstream pier noses, four marker towers, both bank approaches and the hillside directly beside the eastern end.

mapReview.basis: The September 2026 aerial view aligns the three-arch masonry span with the eastern, hillside-side channel. The longer western bridge crosses the adjacent branch. A north-up aerial trace of the 23.03 m eastern deck gives the signed heading. +X follows the deck east by north toward the hillside. +Z faces south by east toward the older photograph. The rounded pier noses face north by west.
mapReview.result: The eastern segment of the retained multi-line road fits the masonry bridge. The west segment is a separate modern crossing.
